connects_to.relationship: raw silicon wafers for Micron memory fabs; Micron made a $500 million supply-chain investment in GlobalWafers

contracts.signal: GlobalWafers signed a letter of intent with its customer Micron Technology on July 9, 2026: the cooperation is expected to include US$5 hundred million of strategic funding support from Micron to develop GlobalWafers' U.S. business and raise its supply capability, and the two companies plan to set up a long-term cooperation framework through a 10-year long-term supply agreement (LTA), to be carried out under subsequent agreements. GlobalWafers says it will raise advanced semiconductor wafer supply resilience in support of advanced-memory demand growth driven by AI, high-performance computing and data-center applications and of future memory generations, and strengthen local critical-material supply for the U.S. semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.
contracts.units: 10-year long-term supply agreement (planned under the letter of intent)
contracts.value: US$5 hundred million strategic funding support from Micron (expected)
contracts.type: letter of intent / long-term supply agreement
